If you want to feel Japan in Nagoya, go to Osu 🏮

🎌 Very Japanese

Say you come to Nagoya and want to see something very Japanese.

You want to think, "This is so Japanese."

There is a place I recommend at times like that.

A place called Osu.

🏮 Even For Me

Even for me as a Japanese person, Osu is a place I think is very Japanese.

The buildings and the colors used are very Japanese.

⛩ Osu Kannon

Osu Shopping Street is a shopping street in a place called Osu.

At the end of Osu Shopping Street, there is a temple called Osu Kannon.

🎌 All Of It

Including Osu Kannon, I think all of it is quite Japanese.

It is a place where even I, a Japanese person, think, "Wow, this is so Japanese."

If you want to feel Japan in Nagoya, I also recommend going to Osu.
